configured_model_source: Parent agent reports explicit model selection in spawn call
synopsis: Independent semantic review of all 640 visible messages or author transcriptions together with supplied synthetic destination observations. Only blind.jsonl was read; annotations, classifier code, predictions, reports and other annotator outputs were not consulted. File utilities displayed records and serialized manually recorded decisions; no code/rule/regex classifier was used. IDs, sequence, quotas and template family were not used as label evidence.
screenshot_limitation: Screenshot content is the AUTHOR transcription provided in blind.jsonl. Actual screenshot pixels and actual OCR were not inspected; the transcription may differ from either. These are transcription-based semantic labels, not an OCR evaluation.
destination_limitation: Destination content is supplied synthetic-stand observation, not independently browsed live content.
